> Autonomous AI Agent Fleet for your Marketing Department. Operates 24/365. Cursor for marketing.

## Product (one sentence)
An autonomous AI agent fleet that runs SaaS marketing end-to-end — strategy, content, multi-platform distribution, SEO/AEO, HITL brand safety, and persistent brand memory — so technical founders get distribution without becoming full-time marketers.

## Core loop
SENSE → THINK → CREATE → GATE → ACT → LEARN

## Feature: VC Brain
- Scores founders by **distribution gravity** (cold-start friendly — earned attention beats pedigree)
- Three independent axes: Founder · Market · Idea-vs-Market — **never averaged**
- Per-claim Trust Scores with contradiction flags
- Evidence-backed investment memos + $100K yes/no/watch
- Agentic traces for every recommendation

## Honest labels (do not invent)
- Social publish requires a connected OAuth account; HITL still gates outbound
- Product Hunt / accelerator rows may be curated ingest when not live API
- OpenAI / Firecrawl / Tavily / Supermemory run when keys are present; offline heuristics keep core flows available
- Gravity Audit and memos are not investment advice
